title: Rav Huna bar Luliani
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bereshit Rabbah 36:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.36.8); Hyman suggests that perhaps the reading should be Rabbi Chiyya bar Luliani, as in [Taanit 25a](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.25a.19-20).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bereshit Rabbah gives Rabbi Huna ben Luliani; Hyman’s heading has Rav Huna bar Luliani.

The linked Taanit gives Rabbi Chiyya bar Lulyani. [Heilprin’s Chiyya notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1267&lang=en) cites the rain story there. Hyman suggests that perhaps Bereshit Rabbah should read Chiyya.
